alertsWritten.instrument: ICO final guidance on Storage and Access Technologies (post-DUAA)
alertsWritten.reasonForAlert: Binding ICO guidance implementing DUAA PECR amendments in force since 2026-02-05. Material changes: 5 new consent exemptions including analytics-without-consent; scope expansion to 'instigators' (directly implicating CMPs); 'simple means of objecting' requirement for exempt categories; PECR fine ceiling raised 35x to GBP 17.5M / 4% global turnover. Requires new banner mode code change in ID-PRIVACY. Flagged as candidate in scan-2026-05-09 and recommended for next cycle by prior orchestrator.

Customer advisory required.
